title: Wi-Fi Reconnect Flap Detection
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes (`uptime:probe`).
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=unifi:event (event_key="EVT_WU_Disconnected" OR event_key="EVT_WU_Connected")
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as wifi_events by hostname _time
| where wifi_events>6
| sort - wifi_events
description: Finds devices that keep disconnecting and reconnecting within the hour, the tell-tale sign of poor coverage, roaming trouble, or a dying radio.
value: Reconnect storms create lag, call drops, and invisible frustration; this query turns those moments into something you can troubleshoot.
implementation: Forward UniFi association events; review clients with frequent reconnect churn and compare them with signal quality or AP placement.
visualization: Hourly table of clients by reconnect event count.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which devices keep dropping off Wi-Fi and hopping right back on again.
